title: NASA Artemis II AROW flight-derived ephemeris
planned_use: mission clock, trajectory, range, speed, geometry, event synchronization
notes: Primary trajectory backbone. Preserve source release/version metadata.

title: Artemis II PDS Mission Archive
planned_use: authoritative index for camera, audio, environment, and mission-document bundles
notes: SPICE bundle was delayed in the initial release; architecture should support later ingestion.

title: Artemis II Orion environmental logger data
data_type: CSV/PDS4 temperature, relative humidity, dew point
planned_use: time-series analysis, change points, mission-context correlation
notes: Two HOBO MX1101 data loggers sampled at 60-second cadence.

title: Artemis II Lunar Science Team outgoing target request
planned_use: link planned lunar observations to mission time, targets, crew actions, and later images/audio
notes: Contains target metadata, timing, descriptions, requested actions, and coordinates for selected observations.

title: Artemis II Preliminary Lunar Science Report
planned_use: impact flashes, color observations, terminator science, eclipse/corona observations, Earth imagery analysis
notes: Narrative/report source; normalize claims separately from raw PDS products.

title: NASA Artemis I Orion heat shield char-loss root cause
planned_use: heritage risk closure thread linking Artemis I root cause to Artemis II trajectory mitigation and postflight results
notes: Do not describe this as an Artemis II pressure-vessel cracking event.

title: NAIRAS 3.0 at NASA CCMC — historical Phase 5B interface
planned_use: historical Phase 5B trajectory-interface preparation; no run output claimed
notes: Retained to preserve repository history. Phase H separately records current NAIRAS Version 4 documentation; do not relabel this 3.0 interface as a Version 4 run.

title: NAIRAS Version 4 at NASA CCMC
data_type: current radiation environment model documentation / runs-on-request capability
planned_use: Phase H current-model documentation, radiation response-chain explanation, and v3.0/v4 evidence-version boundary
notes: Current model documentation is distinct from MissionLab's historical NAIRAS 3.0 interface preparation. No MissionLab Version 4 run is claimed.

title: NASA OMNIWeb
data_type: solar wind, IMF, energetic-particle and geomagnetic context
planned_use: external heliophysics environment synchronized with mission time
notes: External environment must not be mislabeled as astronaut absorbed dose.

title: NOAA Solar Radiation Storm S-scale
planned_use: Phase H physically meaningful pfu scenario control and S1-S5 public reference thresholds
notes: Public scale reference only. Do not present NOAA S categories as Artemis II flight rules or crew-dose values.

title: Artemis II radiation sensors inside Orion
planned_use: HERA and Crew Active Dosimeter public mission context
notes: Public hardware role does not provide MissionLab with private/as-flown individual crew dosimetry.
